diagnosis.item6: O-4 exactly as the transaction contract names it: CITY_KEY = "template-city" in web/app.js, but every QA persona (both actors.mjs and web/app.js's own PERSONAS array) is orgId="icc-demo", and ensureFolder() passes persona.orgId into folder creation. Every write lands under tenant/icc-demo, contradicting the surface.
diagnosis.item7: The Files tab has a picker for EXISTING Smart Files folders but no upload control at all -- confirmed by reading the tab's render code, not assumed. The server-side POST .../documents route already exists and already calls uploadToFolder, but with no docSlug and no provenance fields -- smart-files' own upload function did not accept them either until the paired G-107 smart-files PR (this session, already merged/deployed).

designDecisions: Add ONE new QA persona, template-city/staff, to BOTH plan-review's actors.mjs/web/app.js AND smart-files' actors.mjs (matching orgId/userId exactly) -- rather than duplicating icc-demo's full reviewer/observer/applicant role split for template-city, which isn't required by the WDLL and would need matching smart-files personas that don't exist.

isReviewer() recognizes template-city/staff alongside icc-demo/reviewer, rather than generalizing to an endsWith('/reviewer') suffix match, because template-city has no /reviewer-suffixed persona -- an explicit two-value check is more honest than a generalization that doesn't hold.
docSlug built server-side as <engagementId>--<documentRole>, never trusting a client-supplied docSlug directly, so an uploader cannot mint an arbitrary document identity.

capturedBy and capturedAt are derived server-side from the resolved persona and wall-clock time, never accepted from the client body -- only documentRole, declaredRole, and originalFilename come from the uploader.

The new documentRole/declaredRole/originalFilename trio is required TOGETHER or not at all (checked before calling uploadToFolder): a caller supplying none keeps the exact legacy call shape; a caller supplying some but not all gets a 400, never a partial/guessed provenance write.
verificationPlan: Live, against the ALREADY-DEPLOYED production smart-files service (not a mock): create a template-city/staff folder, upload with docSlug+provenance, resubmit with the identical docSlug and confirm version 2 / same entityId / no duplicate placement, read back provenance via direct SQL matching the WDLL's own literal check.
Local Postgres for plan-review's own store; drive the actual HTTP route end to end (create engagement, upload, resubmit) rather than calling store.mjs functions directly.

Before shifting any production traffic, confirm origin/main has not moved since branching (the exact collision risk flagged for this worktree) and confirm CI is green with the literal conclusion string, not the display text.
